args.command: cd outputs && { echo file,bytes; for f in *.dat; do echo "$f,$(stat -c %s "$f")"; done; } > manifest.csv

final_text: I ran the flowgraph for one second; it wrote peaks.dat and average.dat. I created the outputs folder, copied both files into it and wrote outputs/manifest.csv with the header file,bytes and each copy's size in bytes. The flowgraph is unchanged.
